name: cobol-area-a-line-heuristic
body: area_a_departure judges each sentence's header: inside the PROCEDURE DIVISION a one-word sentence (digits allowed, period possibly after a space) is a paragraph name, outside it only the twelve IDENTIFICATION/ENVIRONMENT paragraph headers are; the 19 COBOL-85 scope terminators plus EXIT, CONTINUE, GOBACK, NEXT and ELSE are never names, COPY and REPLACE may start in either area, and comment-entry lines are exempt. Limit: a statement starting mid-line after a period is not checked, and the comment-entry region ends at any area-A line. Upgrade if a corpus shows false or missed area-A diagnostics.
